exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean section or vaginal delivery in Pune District, India
finding: Women who had a caesarean delivery had a higher risk of postpartum depression at 6 weeks compared to women who had a vaginal delivery, particularly among women younger than 25 years old.
mod_finding: Young women who had a caesarean delivery had a higher risk of postpartum depression at 6 weeks.
